method: Automatic AWQ Marlin, FP16 activations, one concurrent greedy request, one warmup plus three salted requests, 227 input and 64 output tokens. SGLang forward timers count 227 prefill tokens and 63 decode intervals.
sequence: Two separate paired reservations. The integrated prototype and final VF used the same mixed-target policy. Final VF generates its verified Ampere instruction table from ISA descriptions.
